fields.name: National Identity & Civil Registration
fields.description: Services for obtaining national identification, birth and death certificates, and civil registration documents.

fields.name: Immigration & Travel
fields.description: Passport applications, visa services, work permits, and travel-related documentation.

fields.name: Business & Trade
fields.description: Business registration, trading licenses, tax compliance, and enterprise support services.

fields.name: Land & Property
fields.description: Land title searches, property registration, land rates payments, and survey services.

fields.description: Driving licenses, vehicle registration, road permits, and transport-related services.

fields.description: NHIF registration, health services, education records, and professional certifications.

fields.name: National ID Application
